regex.cycleCutMeaning: complete interactions with the cycles cut: going down the hierarchy and back up (zoom out, back, background); shortcuts (jumps to a state of another branch) are not expanded in the regex and are listed in regex.cycles.shortcutTransitions

cycles.meaning: spanning tree from the initial state (by hierarchical name when there is one, otherwise by BFS): tree = from parent to child, back = to an ancestor (closes a cycle), shortcut = to another branch

regex.languageMeaning: standard semantics: matches EXACTLY the sequences of interactions (clicks and hovers) that can be performed from the initial state (without the ones that break the page)
regex.completeInteractionsMeaning: sequences that return to the initial state; every performable sequence is a prefix of one of these
regex.languageOmitted: omitted: the regex exceeds 500000 characters (it grows exponentially when eliminating the states of the dense core: root, root > vis, root > vis > operator, root > vis > controls, root > vis > legend, root > vis > axis, root > vis > operator > layout, root > vis > operator > label, root > vis > operator > encoder, root > vis > operator > distortion, root > vis > operator > filter). The transition table and the comparison against an expected regex are not affected. See regex.explosion in transitions.json.
regex.completeInteractionsOmitted: omitted: the regex exceeds 500000 characters (it grows exponentially when eliminating the states of the dense core: root, root > vis, root > vis > operator, root > vis > legend, root > vis > operator > layout, root > vis > operator > encoder, root > vis > operator > distortion, root > vis > operator > filter). The transition table and the comparison against an expected regex are not affected. See regex.explosion in transitions.json.

partiallyVisibleClicks.meaning: transitions whose element was only partly visible when it was clicked (visible: approximate fraction of its area)

hovers.meaning: hover actions (the pointer enters an element) that change something visible. transient: a highlight or tooltip that disappears on leaving and does not change what can be done (a loop on its state); structural: opens something or leaves a change, leading to another state (its way back is Unhover_); error: doing it breaks the page (reported as unexpected behavior). changes is the observed effect; hovers with no visible effect are not actions (ignored)
